info.title: Miro V2
info.description: Miro is a digital whiteboarding and visual collaboration platform for cross-functional teams. Create and manage boards, add sticky notes, cards, frames, text, and connectors, and share boards with collaborators using the Miro V2 REST API.

tags.name: Items
tags.description: Operations for creating and retrieving board items.

tags.name: Members
tags.description: Operations for sharing boards with collaborators.

tags.name: Connectors
tags.description: Operations for creating lines between items.

get.description: Retrieves a list of boards accessible to the current user.

parameters.name: team_id
parameters.description: Filter boards by team ID.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search boards by name.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field for the results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of boards to return (1-50, default 20).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Offset for pagination from previous response.

total.description: Total number of boards matching the query.

size.description: Number of boards in this response.

post.description: Creates a new Miro board with the specified name and settings.

teamId.description: ID of the team to create the board in.

put.description: Creates a copy of an existing board, including all its content.

parameters.name: copy_from
parameters.description: The ID of the board to copy.

name.description: Name for the copied board. Defaults to Copy of original.

teamId.description: Team ID to place the copied board in.

get.description: Retrieves details for a specific board by its ID.

parameters.name: board_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the board.

patch.description: Updates the name, description, or settings of an existing board.

parameters.name: board_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the board.

post.description: Creates a sticky note on a board with the specified text and color.

parameters.name: board_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the board.

data.description: Content and shape of the sticky note.

content.description: Text content of the sticky note. Supports basic HTML tags.

style.description: Visual style settings for the sticky note.

fillColor.description: Background color of the sticky note.

parent.description: Parent frame to place the item inside.

id.description: Unique identifier of the sticky note.

data.description: Content data of the sticky note.

style.description: Visual style of the sticky note.

post.description: Creates a card item on a board with title, description, assignee, and due date.

parameters.name: board_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the board.

data.description: Card data including title and description.

description.description: Description of the card. Supports HTML.

assigneeId.description: Miro user ID to assign the card to.

style.description: Visual style settings for the card.

cardTheme.description: Color theme for the card as hex color.

parent.description: Parent frame to place the item inside.

get.description: Retrieves all items on a board, optionally filtered by item type.

parameters.name: board_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the board.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter by item type.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum items to return (1-50, default 10).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Cursor for pagination from previous response.

content.description: Text content for sticky notes and text items.

size.description: Number of items in this response.

post.description: Invites one or more users to a board by email with a specified role.

parameters.name: board_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the board.

emails.description: Email addresses to invite to the board.

message.description: Optional invitation message included in the email.

post.description: Creates a frame on a board to visually group and organize items.

parameters.name: board_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the board.

fillColor.description: Background fill color as hex or named color.

id.description: Frame ID. Use as parent.id when creating items inside.

post.description: Creates a text item on a board with the specified content.

parameters.name: board_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the board.

content.description: Text content. Supports HTML tags like p, b, i, a, ul, li.

id.description: Unique identifier of the text item.

post.description: Creates a line connecting two items on a board.

parameters.name: board_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the board.

id.description: ID of the item where the connector starts.
ID of the item where the connector ends.

captions.description: Caption labels on the connector line.

get.description: Retrieves details for a specific item on a board by its ID.

parameters.name: board_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the board.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the item.

content.description: Text content for sticky notes and text items.

id.description: Unique identifier of the board owner.

name.description: Display name of the board owner.

viewLink.description: URL to view the board in Miro.
URL to view the board in Miro.

role.description: Current user role on this board.
